definitionZh: @container CSS at-rule 是有条件的组合规则,将样式应用到封装上下文中. 样式声明通过条件过滤,如果条件属实,则适用于容器内的元素。 当被询问的容器大小、 或滚动状态发生变化时, 对条件进行评估 。
sourceDefinition: The @container CSS at-rule is a conditional group rule that applies styles to a containment context. Style declarations are filtered by a condition and applied to the elements within the container if the condition is true. The condition is evaluated when the queried container size, , or scroll-state changes.
